title: ASIRT investigates fatal police shooting
article: The Alberta Serious Incident Response Team says it's hoping to put the pieces of the puzzle together surrounding Thursday's fatal shooting.
The provincial taskforce says right now there is no timeline as to how long their investigation may take.
Thirty-six-year-old Jonathan Rawlings of Calgary was shot by a Calgary police officer four times and died later in hospital.

Assistant Director of ASIRT Roy Fitzpatrick says they're leaving no stone unturned in this case as they begin to probe police involvement. Fitzpatrick says they hope to the officer involved next week, as well as witnesses and the other male suspect shot by a rubber bullet.

"I don't want to comment on it because we still need to talk to that individual; we need to get cooperation from him. A lot of that would be medical records that need his consent to get," says Fitzpatrick.
Rawlings death is the second fatal shooting by Calgary police in just over two months and one of six active files ASIRT is investigating.
